$note: Normalized from screenshots (ground truth) + raw/hellomonday.json. Raw profile is desktop-only and noisy: a single 22px size dominates (596 nodes) because the grotesque is the workhorse face; display sizes (60/80/90px) and the Clarendon serif are under-sampled but clearly visible in the captures. Hex values rounded to coherent roles; non-greyscale colors come only from project thumbnails, not the chrome.

space.note: 660px is the giant top-pad inside the dark CTA block (text sits low); 40-70px is the inter-column / gutter rhythm.

patterns_to_build: fixed-corner-webgl-sphere — a near-black WebGL sphere bleeding off a viewport edge, position:fixed through scroll, doubling as the nav anchor; decorative brand-object variant distinct from the draggable hero `webgl-thumbnail-sphere`. Spectacle-only; must ship a reduced-motion + no-WebGL fallback (the page is fully functional without it).
motion.note: Raw exposes one 1s `ease` transition (the rotating hero word / hover fades) and is otherwise GSAP/TweenMax JS transforms (~2521 rAF/scroll pass). The 3 @keyframes in the sheet are video.js loader chrome (vjs-spinner-*), NOT design motion. Scroll effects reduce to 2 transform/parallax + 2 pin(fixed) after dropping the opacity 1.00->1.00 no-op; the corner WebGL sphere is fixed/bleed-off-right (visible every frame s00-s10 with the hamburger riding it). IntersectionObserver: 37 targets, all threshold:[0,1] / rootMargin:200px (preload). prefers-reduced-motion NOT respected (prmRules:0).

notes: Greyscale chrome: white bg, warm-paper footer, near-black inset CTA, two ink greys (#2c2d2e text, #c6c5c5 rules/muted). Zero corner radius everywhere except 50% (circular sphere + dots). No shadows — separation is whitespace and hairlines only. Two-axis type system: grotesque for labels/UI/lead-ins, Clarendon-Light serif for names/titles/voice (inverse of the usual serif-body/sans-display split).
